description: This file defines a Flutter widget called StatusBar that displays the current game status, including the current player, game over state, and result. It uses theming and references external classes for theme styling and game results.

classes.name: StatusBar
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays the game status, such as current player, game over message, and results, styled according to theme.

methods.name: StatusBar
methods.description: Constructor for the StatusBar widget, requiring currentPlayer, isGameOver, and result.

methods.name: _playerColor
methods.description: Private method that returns a color based on the player ('X' or 'O').

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the status bar, displaying textual labels and styled containers based on game state.

methods.name: _resultShortText
methods.description: Private method that returns a short text description for the game result.
